source_text.body:
Generate eviction notices from tenant name and balance
A landlord uses Gemini gems to turn a tenant name and balance into eviction notices; it once got a vehicle make wrong, which they corrected.
·
Jul 21, 2026
Done with
GE
Gemini
What they did
A real estate agent and landlord said they built Gemini gems for property tasks. For notices, they enter a tenant's name and the balance due, and the gem automatically drafts 5-day and 14-day eviction notices; the same setup also lets them query bills they've loaded in by asking what remains due before a date.
How it went
They describe it as a workflow they use a lot, alongside listing descriptions and house comps. The thread gives no performance numbers, and the only stated catch nearby is another commenter saying Gemini once misidentified a vehicle make and had to be corrected.
Try it yourself
with
Gemini
Copy prompt
Help me build a reusable Gem that drafts a [type of notice, e.g. notice to pay rent or quit] for a tenant. I'll give it the tenant name, unit address, balance owed, and [other details like vehicle or lease date]; it should fill a template that follows the rules in [my state/jurisdiction] and flag anything it's unsure of or I haven't supplied rather than guessing. Test it with [sample tenant details], show me the draft, and don't treat anything as final until I've checked every fact and the legal wording, since I'll review before sending or serving it.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/GeminiAI/comments/1v0lf8s/whats_one_gemini_feature_you_use_more_than_you
